title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu and Pip | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu the little duck and Pip the kitten on an autumn lake! Coloured leaves twirl down on every "merrily", a little turtle swims beside the boat, and the sky turns golden at sunset.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 1852).
